FreeType bitmap routine reference

Source: https://github.com/freetype/freetype/blob/c4a3c188e82bc5b457390a87630ac782316421a1/src/sfnt/ttsbit.c
License: FreeType License (FTL); see freetype.txt.

go-text/typesetting v0.3.5 font/renderer.go identifies an adaptation of
FreeType's tt_face_load_sbit. It does not pin a FreeType version. The following
copyright notices are retained from the upstream reference checked during this
review, alongside go-text's own source-file notices; this does not assert that
the complete FreeType library is linked into Nudilo.
